title: Offline banner appears when connection drops
steps: 1. Disconnect network while app is open
expected_result: Banner "Mode Offline: Data tersimpan lokal & siap sync." appears below the header and pushes content down, not covering Reset Ekspor / Sync ke Sheets buttons or the page title, on both desktop and mobile widths

title: Reconnect shows a temporary green banner
expected_result: Green "Kembali Online..." banner shown for about 4 seconds, then disappears

title: Direct-form entries made offline sync automatically on reconnect
steps:
1. Go offline
2. Save a transaction via Formulir Langsung
3. Reconnect
expected_result: Transaction shown immediately in-app while offline; auto-syncs to the server once back online

title: Internet-dependent features are blocked offline without crashing
steps: 1. Attempt voice input AI text input Sync and Reset Ekspor while offline
expected_result: Each is rejected with a clear message (see VOICE-07, MAN-06, SYNC-01, SYNC-17); no crash

title: Update banner slides down from the very top and cannot be dismissed
preconditions: A new version has been deployed
steps:
1. Revisit the app after a new version has been deployed
2. Look at the banner position and for any close control
3. Click "Perbarui"
expected_result: "Pembaruan Tersedia" banner slides down from the very top of the screen, above all other elements; no close/X button; stays until updated; "Perbarui" loads the new version

title: Install button appears when not installed; install goes through the browser dialog
preconditions: Open in a supporting browser, not yet installed
expected_result: Install button available in header and Settings; click opens the browser install dialog; after install the button disappears. In-app success toast is NOT required (confirmation comes from the browser notification). Best effort: installed state is remembered so the button does not reappear after refresh in a normal tab

title: Install button is hidden when already running as an installed app
preconditions: App running as an installed PWA
steps: 1. Open the app as an installed PWA

title: iOS and unsupported browsers show manual install guidance
preconditions: Browser without native install prompt support (e.g. iOS Safari)
steps: 1. Open the app in that browser
expected_result: Install button shows manual guidance (e.g. Share -> Add to Home Screen); dialog is fully visible and centered when opened from both the header button and Settings. iOS Safari: "pada bilah navigasi Safari"; iOS Chrome/Firefox/Edge: neutral wording ("di bilah alamat atau menu browser Anda")

title: Manifest values match spec
expected_result: Name "Qicau - Pencatat Pengeluaran Suara"; 192/512 icons + maskable; standalone mode; portrait orientation; theme color #0a0a0a; 3 shortcuts (Catat, Riwayat, Ringkasan)

title: Manifest shortcuts open the correct tab
steps:
1. Launch the app via the "Riwayat" shortcut
2. Launch the app via the "Ringkasan" shortcut
expected_result: Opens Riwayat tab (?tab=history) / Ringkasan tab (?tab=monthly) respectively

title: HTML response is not cached by the server
steps: 1. Inspect response headers for the HTML page
expected_result: Cache-Control: no-store on the HTML response for every route including unknown SPA routes; hashed /assets/* files are long-cached (immutable). Test against a production build or the Worker - the local Vite dev server sends no-cache instead

title: Global toasts appear on every tab and the login page
steps: 1. Trigger a global action (Sync Reset install) success and failure from different tabs
expected_result: Toast shown regardless of active tab (including login page); green for success, red for error; auto-dismiss about 5s; closable with the close icon

title: A new toast replaces an existing one
preconditions: A global toast is currently shown
steps: 1. Trigger a second global toast while the first is still visible
expected_result: The old toast is replaced by the new one

title: Pending update installs automatically on return unless a Sync/Reset is running
steps:
1. With the update banner showing, switch to another tab/app briefly and return
2. Repeat while a Sync or Reset is in progress
expected_result: Page reloads by itself with the new version, no click needed; if a Sync/Reset is running the page does NOT reload and the banner stays
